meta.source_note: Steam 公开搜索页提供发售日期而非小时级发布时间；本报告按发售日期从新到旧选取最新条目。

items.title: I'm Making a Monster
items.short_description: Piece by piece, you pour your soul into the monster. This is your burden and you bear it willingly. Your friends think that this is unhealthy.

items.title: Armed Snake
items.short_description: Armed Snake is a top-down action roguelike where you control a snake on a grid battlefield. Grow your body, survive enemy waves, and evolve powerful upgrades to clear the run. Each run is a fresh challenge. Pick your playstyle, survive the waves, defeat the bosses, and build the deadliest snake.

items.title: VELATO
items.short_description: VELATO is a Poker-Bluff Roguelike Deckbuilder where players build a Joker-driven economy engine, manipulate AI opponents through bluffing, and survive escalating table pressure across each run.

items.title: World: 23806
items.short_description: 进入一个神秘的程序化世界，在第一人称射击与动作类 Rogue 循环中战斗、搜刮与成长。你将面对游荡的敌人，开启散落的宝箱，收集枪械、近战武器与装备，并用每次冒险获得的资源强化角色。继续深入可能得到更好的奖励，也可能失去本局成果；及时返回则能保留收获，为下一次进入做准备。每一次世界生成都会带来不同的地形、节奏、敌人分布和掉落选择。死亡不是终点，而是下一轮挑战的开始。不断调整你的武器和路线，在未知世界中走得更远。

items.title: Forge Maiden Demo
items.short_description: Forge Maiden 将你的专注时间锻造成武器。使用番茄工作法，鉴定随机词条，完成顾客订单，并帮助一位签订契约的少女赚取 10,000 枚金币，重获自由。

items.title: Chrono Tower
items.short_description: Chrono Tower is a soulslike command RPG focused on 1-on-1 mind games. Read your enemy, choose the best response, raise your win rate, and kill at 100%. Build your own playstyle with stats, equipment, skills, and magic as you climb a tower twisted by time.

items.title: At Face Value Demo
items.short_description: Every card is worth exactly what it says, so draw a few thousand of them. At Face Value is a witty, deceptively deep incremental about turning one humble deck of cards into a runaway point-printing machine. Draw, upgrade, shuffle, repeat… just one more time.

items.title: Schizophrenia: The Last Shift
items.short_description: Remembering the past while corruption occurs, you are set out to finish the remainder of your shift until you cannot anymore. Stock the shelves using your forklift and be a productive member of society while evading the inner demons within you in this horror survival to meet quota.

items.title: Nyctophobia
items.short_description: Nyctophobia is a first person horror game where you play as a new motel worker who is afraid of the dark. As soon as you step into a dark area you start hallucinating scary faces, your goal is to survive your shift.

items.title: Cig Walk
items.short_description: A place where civilization burned out long ago, but the snow still falls, and the wind still howls between dead apartment blocks. There are no missions. No miracles. Just the cold, the silence, and the soft glow of a cigarette. Relax in this doomer walking simulator and smoke them if you got them.

items.title: アンダーワールドモンスターズピンボール Demo
items.short_description: Introducing *Underworld Monsters Pinball*, a fresh take on pinball where you aim for high scores with a cast of quirky monster characters riding the ball! Hone your skills and aim for your personal best score!

items.title: Bounce Ball Clicker
items.short_description: Bounce Ball Clicker is a stage-based clicker & puzzle game where you place various items on a 7x7 grid and bounce balls to collect a target number of coins. Build the optimal route while considering item synergies, and earn the target amount with maximum speed and efficiency!

items.title: Idle Village
items.short_description: An interactive idle game with a relaxing medieval setting. Start from nothing and slowly build your village by gathering resources and hiring villagers to populate and help build.

items.title: Charon's Obol Demo
items.short_description: Challenge Death himself in a coin-flipping roguelike across the Greek Underworld. Build a tableau of mythic coins, discover unexpected synergies, and wield the powers of Olympus to bend fate in your favor.

items.title: Edicts of the Truthsinger: The Orb of Artemagus Demo
items.short_description: Six witnesses, six suspects, and thousands of discoverable lines of dialog. You're the fantasy detective on the case of a stolen magical artifact, and in order to determine the truth you'll have to cross examine, interrogate, and reference all your resources to catch the thief before time runs out.

items.title: Pictures at an Exhibition
items.short_description: Aozora Haru, a troubled, recently orphaned art student, finds it hard to attach much meaning to many of the things in his life. Through the meaningful bonds he has created with the people close to him, however, he begins to understand that life is much more important than it initially seems.

items.title: FINIS ACTUS
items.review_summary: 褒贬不一 此游戏的 11 篇用户评测中有 63% 为好评。
items.short_description: 1891年，伦敦。在一位著名魔术师的宅邸里，现实与疯狂之间的界限正在崩塌。许多自诩聪慧之人在这条走廊里迷失了方向。在帷幕落下之前，你能否洞悉幻象背后的真相，抑或将成为这场悲剧的牺牲品？

items.title: Chrome Shadow Demo
items.short_description: A 2D pixel-art detective adventure where you investigate a brutal murder in a city drowning in corruption, secrets, and political tension. Search locations, question suspects, collect evidence, and uncover a truth that was never meant to surface.

items.title: 101 Dogs Hidden in New York
items.review_summary: 好评 此游戏的 10 篇用户评测中有 100% 为好评。
items.short_description: 加入这场冒险，在精心打造的纽约景观中，探索101只狗狗的藏身之处🐾。🏆赢取海量成就。你能找到多少只狗狗🐶呢？🔎快行动吧！⏱️

items.title: FishPond
items.short_description: 建造一个每条鱼都拥有独特遗传编码的活水池塘。繁育稀有特征，平衡氧气与饥饿，解锁新物种，并看着你的生态系统实时谱写自己的原声带。部分是模拟器，部分是放置游戏，部分是一场进行得无比精彩的科学实验。

items.title: Nin Ninja RESCUE MISSION
items.short_description: Nin Ninja Rescue Mission is an action, adventure, platform, and endless runner game. Run, face dangerous enemies, dodge traps, defeat enemies, and use your skills to complete a rescue mission.

items.title: Wizard Gold
items.short_description: An incremental game about an ancient stone that turns wood into gold. You collect fallen wood and feed it to the stone for gold, then hire wizards, buy upgrades, and cast spells. Prestige to start once again with permanent power to help you feed the stone even more.

items.title: The King's Game: Through the Veil
items.short_description: The King's Game is a 3D chess game where the pieces are concealed from your opponent. with two game modes; standard two-player chess and a circular board three-player chess variant. All across multiple atmospheric 3D environments.

items.title: Mic Simulator
items.short_description: You are a mic! a Romanian skinless grilled sausage! on the grill! A third-person comedy sim about doing absolutely nothing while you're slowly getting smoked. Maybe you can listen to the radio? It's a nice day outside.

items.title: a monkey
items.short_description: 《AMonkey》是一款以《西游记》为背景的快节奏2D牌组构筑Roguelike。您将化身猕猴，在随机生成的取经路上展开冒险。游戏核心循环清晰明快：战斗 → 三选一获取卡牌/法宝 → 构筑/升级牌组 → 挑战更强Boss。 游戏的核心乐趣在于深度策略构筑。您可自由组合超过60张效果各异的卡牌，形成独特战斗流派，例如追求一击制胜的爆发流、侧重高频攻击的连击流，或依靠格挡反击的防御流。 游戏内容丰富，包含10多种能改变战局的强力法宝，以及10位以上拥有独特机制的首领Boss。每一次失败都意味着下一次能带着更丰富的策略开局，保证了极高的重玩价值。 准备好迎接这场充满策略与随机性的快节奏卡牌冒险了吗？

items.title: Mythfall Demo
items.short_description: Mythfall is a fast-paced bullet hell MMO where skill and strategy determine survival. Battle relentless monsters, loot powerful gear, and grow stronger as you fight to defend your homeland from the mighty wizard Alivarg.

items.title: Master Fall
items.short_description: Master Fall is a 2D psychological horror puzzle-platformer where players rotate the world to manipulate gravity, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets as reality slowly collapses into a surreal nightmare.

items.title: Incarnation - Lifetimes
items.short_description: After years of development, many failures and redesigns, Incarnation - Lifetimes final form is taking shape.

items.title: Pickel: The Mysterious Mine
items.short_description: 一场神秘的大地震袭来，小镇居民销声匿迹。化身为主角“皮科”，深入探索黑暗的地下世界。随着每一次挥动镐头，奇异的痕迹接连浮现……越往深处走，小镇隐瞒的巨大真相就越清晰。在这座矿山的尽头，究竟有什么在等待着你？

items.title: Twelve Boxes
items.short_description: 你的任务只有一个：把箱子搬到卡车上。 听起来再简单不过了。 但这栋房子并不正常。 各种异常现象潜伏其中，而发现它们，是你逃离这场无尽搬运工作的唯一方法。 12 个箱子。 1 条规则。 千万别出错。

items.title: Yips!
items.short_description: Throw the ball, chase it, and climb higher. Yips! is a pixel-art precision platformer where you must overcome unpredictable innings using a single baseball and carefully aimed throws.

items.title: Irondrive Demo
items.short_description: Your base is moving. Your crew is exhausted. Manage task priorities, automate critical repairs, and keep your colonists alive as your fortress drives through hell.

items.title: City Cardz
items.short_description: Collect 1200+ city cards from 600+ different cities, build your deck and compete in strategic card battles inspired by cities from around the world. Discover unique card abilities, different combinations, and interesting city facts as you outsmart the opponents.

items.title: Dodgeball Blast Demo
items.short_description: 《Dodgeball Blast》是一款轻松有趣、动作感十足的 Boss Rush 游戏！ 闪避、接球、投掷，在史诗级战斗中奋战！挑战拥有独特能力的强大 Boss，向终极躲避球大师的目标迈进！

items.title: An Adventure in Arabic
items.short_description: An Adventure in Arabic is a series of games that teaches Arabic Language. Chapter One, introduces Arabic Alphabet. Learn the various shapes and pronunciation of each letter while enjoying playing an Adventure RPG. The game has something to offer for all ages, feature rich and full of activities.

items.title: Where Is Mommy
items.short_description: Trapped in a bazaar that twists with every turn, you are a lost child searching for your mother. Watch for subtle anomalies in the shifting environment to survive the loop. In this retro-inspired world, nothing is as it seems. Can you find her before the cycle swallows you whole?

items.title: The Pawn Broker
items.short_description: The Pawn Broker is an atmospheric horror economic survival game. Run a cursed pawnshop, analyze every item that comes through for signs of theft or dark curses, and make high-stakes decisions to stay profitable before your five days are up.

items.title: 1.80战神微变
items.short_description: 全新传奇《1.80 战神微变》打破传统战法道界限！全新「神器使者」单职业登场，集近战爆发、远程范围、辅助增益于一身！

items.title: Overlab
items.short_description: Combine atoms to create molecules and fulfill orders to survive as long as possible.

items.title: FOCUS
items.short_description: 监控画面正在被一点点改写。找出变化之处并予以报告的点击式观察恐怖游戏。

items.title: The Incident
items.short_description: The Incident is a first-person psychological horror game where you explore a closed circus, destroy evidence before investigators arrive, and avoid someone still inside watching your every move.

items.title: SavingSanta
items.short_description: VR Virtual Reality, Single Player, Runner where you save Santa from those that want to stop him from giving gifts to the world

items.title: Spirit of the Dome
items.short_description: 在这款即时战略风格的塔防游戏中，在日渐衰败的世界中抵御源源不断的敌人浪潮和黑暗势力！

items.title: Escape From Ashville Demo
items.short_description: 搜刮、战斗并撤离——否则失去一切。 一款高风险的撤离射击游戏，专注于生存、战术战斗和关键决策。

items.title: Fantasy World Simulator
items.short_description: Open a Pixie shop and dive into an adventure with whimsical creatures. Tame, train, and evolve Pixie characters, then explore the vibrant city with them. Manage your shop, serve customers, and grow your business. Join now and create your own Pixie legend!

items.title: The Daily Parlay
items.short_description: Challenge your friends in a high-stakes blend of card strategy and brutal arena combat, where a round of President decides your rank! Your hierarchy dictates your power in battle, letting you exploit your friends from the President's throne, or forcing you to beg for mercy as the Scum!

items.title: Infernal Gate
items.short_description: Dive into Infernal Gate and its engaging Story Mode, driven by a rich dialogue system. Annihilate enemies using a highly complex system of ranged, melee, and throwable weapons. Master your loadout with a deep inventory system to adapt and survive every brutal encounter.

items.title: 五行策(WuXing Card)
items.short_description: 五行策是一款融合中国传统五行元素的策略卡牌游戏，你将通过巧妙搭配英雄技能与各类道具，构筑强力连携，冲击极限高分，在变幻莫测的战局中寻找属于自己的制胜之道。

items.title: Son of Beach Demo
items.short_description: Start as a Beach Caretaker Intern. Clean up trash left behind by tourists and recycle it to unlock powerful new tools. Follow the changing tides to dig up hidden treasures beneath the sand. Catch seafood, run your own seafood stand, and sell rare coastal collectibles in your treasure shop.

items.title: JULPAE
items.short_description: JULPAE is a free-to-play 4-player online card battle game with a Korean-inspired atmosphere. Learn the flow quickly in 1v1 duels, then infer hidden teams, play or pass, and read the match through timing, decisions, and mind games.

items.title: Adira Nusantara
items.short_description: Master authentic Silat combat as Adira, a fierce heroine battling flesh-eating monsters to break a curse on her village. Experience a unique fantasy world rich with South-East Nusantara culture, stunning visuals, and an evolving arsenal of powerful weapons. Prepare for an unforgettable journey!

items.title: Rootbound Enigma
items.short_description: Rootbound Enigma is a first-person puzzle adventure where curiosity leads to treasure, and mistakes lead to danger. Solve puzzles, overcome traps and parkour challenges, and explore atmospheric underground ruins.

items.title: Renz Tower Defense
items.short_description: Fast-paced minimalist tower defense featuring upgradeable towers, economy management, and escalating enemy waves.

items.title: Runaway Dog Demo
items.short_description: In Runaway Dog, embark on an arcade adventure. Explore 3 unique maps, battle enemies, and overcome obstacles in a fast-paced, fun, and addictive journey to rescue your little dog.

items.title: BrainRot Defender
items.short_description: Defend your Lifenode from waves of Scrollers, Trolls, and Doomscrollers in this chaotic 2D arena shooter. Upgrade, survive, and beat the algorithm.

items.title: Brick Game
items.short_description: A retro-inspired classic arcade brick-breaker

items.title: Speed King Demo
items.short_description: Race as anything from pigs to firetrucks in a chaotic 3D racer where every competitor has unique abilities and every track brings unexpected challenges.

items.title: The neon undead
items.short_description: Rock and wreck you way through two tap shoot 'em up game, with 30–40 minutes gameplay. With wild settings from a quiet log cabin to the circus and the various settings, fighting in the name of revenge

items.title: Syndeo-Complex
items.review_summary: 褒贬不一 此游戏的 23 篇用户评测中有 65% 为好评。
items.short_description: In Syndeo-Complex you will explore five different environments connected by a hub. Each level has its own mechanics, weapons, enemies and bosses. The Keli, small droids, will (probably) guide you in your quest.

items.title: UpDown&Shot Demo
items.short_description: Load the revolver and guess the dealer's number. Wrong? Then put the barrel to your head and pull the trigger.

items.title: Lizard Slayer Demo
items.short_description: A pixelated adventure doom-like RPG set in Slavic mythology.

items.title: For the Crown
items.short_description: A puzzle logistics builder where lemming-like workers transport resources across a limited island. Create production chains, optimize routes, upgrade your castle and solve increasingly complex space and logistics challenges. The island never gets bigger. Your logistics problems do.

items.title: SharedScreen Wagons 2 Demo
items.short_description: 单屏本地多人混乱。最多8名玩家、8个手柄、3个键盘。快节奏回合、锦标赛和友情压力测试。装载、卸载、抢道、拆毁——物流撑不住。

items.title: 退款 Demo
items.short_description: 《退款》是一款方格解谜游戏。收费的格子会开出退款单,使用退款单不只退钱:它会把你退进墙里、反向吹飞、或者倒回时间、重置地图!50 个手工关卡,每一枚金币都要精打细算。

items.title: 文物修复师
items.short_description: 在这款2D拼图游戏中，你要扮演一位文物修复师修复破碎的文物。

items.title: Grandpa's Euchre
items.short_description: Grandpa's Euchre - Rule #1: NO TABLE TALK!!!!!! This is the card game version of Euchre that my Grandpa taught me. I grew up in Illinois and we played this at every family gathering.

items.title: Chronocide Demo
items.short_description: Chronocide is a chaotic co-op action trap defense game where you and your friends use weapons and cleverly positioned physics-based traps to stop endless undead hordes. Shoot, burn, crush, throw, impale, poison, and freeze anything that gets too close. Play solo or with up to 3 other players.

items.title: デモンズゲート with サバゲでGo! Demo
items.short_description: 享受角色养成。超过100个角色槽位。自动推进的派遣系统。超过50个关卡。也可全程自动推进。 战术角色扮演游戏（Tactical RPG） 策略角色扮演游戏（SRPG） 基于网格的回合制战术游戏 日式回合制战术RPG系列

items.title: Random Fantasy Defense
items.short_description: 融合塔防与 Roguelike 玩法的奇幻策略游戏。召唤获得诸神祝福的英雄，适应命运女神带来的随机恩赐，抵御黑暗势力对 秘法大陆 Mystologia 的侵袭。

items.title: Hot Dogs, Horseshoes & Hand Grenades
items.review_summary: 好评如潮 此游戏的 619 篇用户评测中有 98% 为好评。 此产品的总体评价是基于您的偏好用以您语言撰写的评测计算得出的。
items.short_description: Do you like hot dogs? How about horseshoes? Hand grenades? (everyone likes hand grenades) Anyway, we've got all that, and guns. SO MANY GUNS. So if you like ordnance, meat, and far too many groan-worthy puns, this is the VR sandbox game for you.

items.title: 简易日式麻将
items.short_description: 这是一款面向日本麻将爱好者与新手玩家的轻量级麻将游戏。游戏采用清晰的 3D 牌桌表现，支持多种常见对局模式，并提供实用的胡牌牌型提示与详细的结算信息，帮助玩家更轻松地理解局势、学习规则、提升牌技。无论你是刚接触日麻的新手，还是想随时来一局练习的人，都可以在这里享受简单、直接、无广告的人机麻将体验。

items.title: CORRUPT.EXE
items.short_description: CORRUPT.EXE is a neon roguelite where you play the malware. Swarm-survival action with evolving weapons, a 225-combo fusion system, and an adaptive antivirus that profiles your movement, learns your habits, and hunts you smarter every run. Infect. Evolve. Extract — or go endless.

items.title: SimulLogistics: RoboHands
items.short_description: Become a member of the logistics center by controlling the robot's hands!

items.title: Paironix Demo
items.short_description: A fast-paced, rogue-like tile-matching adventure! Connect identical pairs to unleash powerful magic spells, adapt to shifting grids, and draft game-changing upgrades. Can you survive the ever-evolving trials in this striking minimalist vector world?

items.title: ARC Aquarium Demo
items.short_description: 收集鱼类，扩展你的水族箱，赚取金钱并解锁装饰。喂养鱼儿、清洁鱼缸，按自己的节奏享受轻松的 2D 放置成长。

items.title: Last Guest at Sunset
items.short_description: Investigate a replayable Hollywood murder mystery where everyone has something to hide. Question guests, uncover contradictions, and identify the killer before they escape justice.

items.title: Dungeon door
items.short_description: Explore ever-changing depths in Dungeon Door, a 2D pixel art action roguelike. Open doors to face unique challenges and master strategic directional combat with your sword and shield. Collect items, learn enemy patterns, and survive the mysteries

items.title: Escape Them Demo
items.short_description: A silent stealth horror game. No weapons, no power just hiding spots, tricks, and nerve. Find the key, escape the house, and don't let them hear you

items.title: 动次打次
items.short_description: 一只喜欢音乐的桌面宠物。更准确地说，它喜欢你喜欢的音乐。 平时，它会安静地待在桌面上陪伴你。当音乐响起，它便会架起鼓槌，跟随节拍开始演奏。 无论你正在工作、学习，还是沉浸在喜爱的旋律中，它都会陪在你的桌面一角，用自己的方式加入音乐。 播放一首歌，看看它今天会带来怎样的演出吧。

items.title: Huiyu AI旅行 Demo
items.short_description: Huiyu AI Trip 是一款交互式旅行影像体验。一种可操控的视觉旅程——按住 W/D 让画面向前推进，按住 S/A 让时间向后回退，松开即停。所有画面通过 Canvas 帧序列实时渲染，正反向切换丝滑无闪。内置多系列旅行内容、25 种语言界面，带你用全新的方式探索世界各地的风景。

items.title: VLCNP Story Demo
items.short_description: Beneath their goofy long-faced looks lies a surprisingly serious action-adventure. Awaken as Akim and Very Long Leelee after 10,000 years of slumber, recover your lost memories, rouse your fallen comrades, and rise to defeat a great evil!

items.title: CHIPSTACK
items.short_description: A desktop idle casino that runs while you game, queue, browse, or work — earning chips every second. Auto-play blackjack, slots, roulette with your bets and strategies. Plus 3 quick-play games like Video Poker. Toggle card counting, equip powerful mods or play pure, and chase the highest chipstack!

items.title: Rescue Dogs vs Aliens Tower Defense
items.short_description: Command heroic rescue dogs in a colorful tower defense battle against alien invaders. Build, upgrade, unlock heroes, defend strange battlefields, and survive wave after wave in RDVA-TD: Rescue Dogs vs Aliens.

items.title: Mercenary Brotherhood Demo
items.short_description: A deep turn‑based tactics RPG featuring emergent stories, procedural world events, enemy factions, magical loot with drawbacks, and a fully simulated fantasy sandbox. Build your mercenary company, survive brutal battles, and uncover new content. Solo‑dev indie project with active development.

items.title: DRUMP SIMULATOR
items.review_summary: 好评 此游戏的 12 篇用户评测中有 100% 为好评。
items.short_description: A satirical game where you make choices and play mini-games as the American President Tonald Drump.

items.title: OFS
items.short_description: 在这款快节奏街机恐怖游戏中，活过五个一分钟的班次。分拣货物、清除可疑包裹、挡住三只小小入侵者；赚取赏金、购买黑客程序，并在班次之间续保医疗保险。短局快节奏，压力拉满，外加满屏荒诞的企业作风。

items.title: Choose Your Paul!
items.short_description: 组建怪异 Paul，打爆整局。 Choose Your Paul 是一款策略 roguelite 自动战斗游戏：选择独特 Trainer，捕捉名为 Paul 的奇异生物，通过站位、升级和协同打造强力构筑，在充满战斗、精英、商店、事件与 Boss 的分支路线中推进。

items.title: SpriteArcana Demo
items.short_description: Sprite Arcana 是专为美术人员与游戏开发者打造的高级 2D 制作管线。创建、制作动画并导出自定义素材，或使用直观的 2D 程序化工具无缝生成 3D 地形。轻松与团队分享项目，或构建专业的素材包。

items.title: FLOWORKS Demo
items.short_description: 一款节点式自动化 × 放置工厂建造游戏。原料沿着你铺设的连线流动，每经过一台机器就变换形态。排除瓶颈、优化布局、扩张贸易版图，最终称霸机器人产业。零美术素材——所有画面与音效均由代码生成。

items.title: OUTWORKS Demo
items.short_description: 建造高耸的立体要塞，守住防线。层层叠楼、立起城墙，并按高度部署炮塔，抵御从四面逼近核心、不断升级的地面与飞行机械大军——然后看着一座坍塌的高塔将一切一同拖垮。一款精炼、霓虹、纯代码打造的基地防御 Roguelite。

items.title: Ruin Blade Demo
items.short_description: 《遗迹之刃》是一款专注于近战砍杀的俯视角战斗+地牢探索的游戏。 你将以佣兵的身份深入古代遗迹。直面潮水般的怪物，在危机四伏的环境中搏杀出你的道路。

items.title: AR Basketball
items.short_description: AR Basketball is a long-term basketball franchise simulator where team chemistry, economics, fan growth, player personalities, and league history matter just as much as winning championships. Build your organization across 100 seasons and chase multiple paths to greatness.

items.title: Paradise Corner 2
items.short_description: Paradise Corner 2 is a cozy and relaxing casual clicker game.

items.title: RUPTURR
items.short_description: Develop your nation, command your army, and dominate the world in a real-time strategy game combining economic management, diplomacy, technological progress, and military conquest.

items.title: Mandate of Galactic Empires
items.short_description: A logistics-focused turn-based space 4X. Govern through Administrative Nodes, connect systems with wormhole infrastructure, assign population to production and research, and expand only as far as your empire can support.

items.title: Purrfect Slide
items.short_description: A cute, bubbly, and cozy match-3 puzzle game! Slide adorable colorful cats, trigger massive chain reactions with Bomb and Line cats, and chase high scores in Fever Mode. Kick back, relax to procedural cozy music, and unlock over 60 achievements in this purr-fectly relaxing puzzle experience.

items.title: Mars Clicker Demo
items.short_description: 一款以火星为背景的放置点击游戏。钻取水晶，建立殖民帝国，运营精炼厂生成暗物质，并触发声望重置以更强大的姿态重新开始。你能抵达无限水晶吗？

items.title: American Revolutionary War
items.short_description: Fight through the American War of Independence in a tactical wargame of field battles, frontier warfare, fortified positions, and campaigns for control of the colonies. Command American, British, Loyalist, German, Native allied, and French forces across 148 scenarios and four campaigns.

items.title: Bepe War
items.short_description: Bepe War is a chaotic war simulator with unique missions and a sandbox mode. Drive any vehicle you can imagine, enable wild mutators, and enjoy brutal ragdolls!

items.title: Cicadia
items.short_description: Cicadia is a free rogue-like first person shooter indie game. Kill bugs and collect Bile as you uncover the hidden truth of a self-forsaken empire. Challenge bosses, cull swarms, and build an unstoppable loadout in Cicadia!

items.title: The Laws of Probability
items.short_description: You have exactly 5. Bread is 4, the bus fare to school is 3. What do you give up? In this short narrative experience, you play as 13-year-old Adam. Confront an interface that reacts to a painful reality, and discover that freedom of choice is sometimes nothing but a privilege.

items.title: Teen Hustler Demo
items.short_description: Build your digital empire from a cramped room to a high-tech penthouse. Code, hack, mine crypto, and manipulate the dark web in this deep 3D economic sandbox simulator. Stay in the shadows, manage your hardware, and don't get caught by the police!

items.title: The Hollow Road: Prologue
items.short_description: A psychological horror prologue where a strange house, a silent church, and something lurking in the dark pull you into a waking nightmare. Explore, uncover hidden truths, and survive what waits beyond the last door.

items.title: Hyper_Sea_5000
items.short_description: Neo-Retro Arcade Shooter. Trapped in a warp cube, for your crimes against the Cube Federation, you must fly and shoot around, use charge shots, mid-air dodges, and power crystals in the most advance ship in the galaxy and fight a relentless onslaught of various "cubes."

items.title: Compliance Auditor
items.short_description: Find the discrepancies. File the report. Survive the exit interview. Are you ready to balance the books?

items.title: Furgon Magic Trader Demo
items.short_description: 在旅行车中成为一名森林炼金术士！种植草药、收集稀有材料、在炼金机器上制作药剂、与森林居民交易并探索新地点。从简单的提取物到强大的灵药

items.title: Voxel Breakers Demo
items.short_description: Voxel Breakers - 一款轻松的增量游戏，你可以破坏体素，购买并升级破坏机器人，然后看着它们替你越来越快地破坏体素。

items.title: Capy Farm Demo
items.short_description: A short incremental game where you build a farm run entirely by capybaras. Expand your fields, automate production, earn massive profits, and outperform rival farms to win the Grand Harvest Competition.

items.title: Ian's Rocket
items.short_description: A history-based, strategy, open-world game in which a nation's economy is built from scratch by utilizing all available resources. Create cities and wonders, hire labor, sell crafted products, and build armies. Meet historical figures who will either fight to stop your efforts or trade with you.

items.title: Leukocyte Demo
items.short_description: 单人或与好友一起畅玩的动作冒险游戏。与病毒和细菌战斗，获得 DNA 突变能力，并在探索人体的过程中不断解锁新技能，挑战强大的首领。

items.title: Battle For Embolia
items.review_summary: 褒贬不一 此游戏的 251 篇用户评测中有 43% 为好评。
items.short_description: 《Battle For Embolia》是一款节奏快速的独立 MMORPG，拥有灵敏的战斗手感、有意义的成长系统和持续更新的内容。探索不断扩展的世界，挑战强大的 Boss，并通过反馈参与游戏开发。免费游玩，无付费取胜机制。

items.title: Secret Cats - Independence Day
items.short_description: 进入迷人的《Secret Cats - Independence Day》世界，这是一款隐藏物品游戏，你的任务是发现隐藏在令人惊叹的手绘艺术作品中的每一只猫。让你敏锐的眼睛和好奇心引导你完成这段迷人的旅程。

items.title: Important People of History: Presidents - George Washington
items.short_description: Learn all about George Washington in this visual novel biography containing rare photos from inside the Washington Monument, Washington's home at Mount Vernon, and much more. Soldier, General, Spymaster, and President - this is George Washington! Proudly made in Washington’s home state of Virginia

items.title: Important People of History: Presidents - Thomas Jefferson
items.short_description: Learn all about Thomas Jefferson in this visual novel biography containing rare photos of the room where the Declaration of Independence was signed, Jefferson’s Monticello home, and much more. Writer, Diplomat, President - this is Thomas Jefferson! Proudly made in Jefferson’s home state of Virginia

items.title: Conqueror's Stage
items.short_description: No fixed maps. No scripted history. No tutorial treadmill. Conqueror's Stage is a real-time grand strategy across five ages - where every decision trades against another. Grand strategy, finally designed to be finished.

items.title: A Vessel of Frustration Demo
items.short_description: You return to your hometown but no one recognizes you. But that doesn’t matter, because you are not here for them. You are here for her. Midgårdsormen, singer and artist, pervert and goddess, a being truly out of this world.

items.title: XENOFLEKT Demo
items.short_description: XENOFLEKT is a roguelite space shooter where you will turn enemy bullets into armory: dash into enemy fire to parry and deflect shots, heal your ship, and trigger devastating counter-attacks. Unlock parts, plug-in unique perks with satellites, and get ready to master hundreds of deadly synergies.

items.title: Olga Doesn't Die
items.short_description: The imperial family's advisor is a witch, a hag, the devil in disguise. A historical drama yuri visual novel set during a time of political tumult wherein an immortal finds both love and suffering.

items.title: Auto Empire Tycoon Demo
items.short_description: 从20世纪50年代的一家小型工厂和单一经销店起步。研究新技术，设计汽车，管理生产，让经销店保持充足库存，并在这款等距视角经营模拟游戏中超越竞争对手，打造属于自己的汽车帝国。

items.title: Marshmallow Story: in Marshmallow Village
items.short_description: This story follows Marshmallow, the protagonist, as he sets off on his adventure to become a beautiful and wonderful marshmallow, but first to search for the missing shopkeeper of Marshmallow Village. Progress through the story with an engaging plot and science puzzles to find the shopkeeper!

items.title: Re:メタモルフォーゼ・キャンディーナ
items.short_description: All girls can transform with candy. A short branching visual novel about a mysterious candy shop and the girls who go there. What candy will you choose?

items.title: Under Tower Idle
items.short_description: 在这款3D放置点击冒险游戏中，建造、扩张并自动化你的岛屿帝国。收集资源，训练部队，征服危险的地下城。

items.title: Snow Route
items.short_description: Snow Route is a dynamic 3D driving game where a true winter adventure awaits! Get behind the wheel of a truck and drive along snowy roads to the finish line.

items.title: LIVORA
items.short_description: LIVORA is a choice-driven life simulation where money, work, relationships, health, family, weather, world events and pressure all connect. Build a life, face the consequences, recover from mistakes, chase ambition, fall in love, start again, and see how different every life can become.

items.title: Crop and Claw 2 Demo
items.short_description: Crop and Claw 2 is an Adventure-RPG about dragons, plants, memories, and more. Delve into a whole new continent of secrets and unearth the roots of the strange events going on.

items.title: Cleanup Crew Demo
items.short_description: A space station has gone dark and its captive alien specimens are loose. Fight through procedurally generated rooms, solve each planet's terminal puzzle, and unlock new weapons as you clear three hostile worlds in this 2D roguelite.

items.title: Ice Cream Man
items.short_description: ICE CREAM MAN is a first person PSX-style horror game. After a late-night gaming session, your walk home turns into a nightmare. Navigate unfamiliar backyards, jump fences and hide in the shadows to escape a murderous Ice Cream Man. Can you make it home alive? Or do you have a rocky road ahead?

items.title: Fading Reel Demo
items.short_description: 复古棕褐 Roguelike——带领锁链相连的小队闯过 22 波敌人。地图事件撕裂阵型，里程碑波次补充新队友、增强火力。Linked Blink、单局升级、19 种 Evolution 与永久 meta 天赋树，助你击败最终 Boss Hydra。

items.title: Draw of Destiny
items.short_description: A dark fantasy roguelite deckbuilder where cards evolve as you play. Build lethal synergies, adapt your deck before every battle, and fight through a demon-ravaged world of brutal tactical choices.

items.title: Tech Store & Repair Simulator
items.review_summary: 褒贬不一 此游戏的 18 篇用户评测中有 66% 为好评。
items.short_description: 建立属于你的终极科技商店帝国！在开放世界中从批发商处购买各种电子产品，亲手整理货架，并向顾客销售最新款的智能手机、平板电脑和配件。你不仅是个老板，还可以通过掌握专业的硬件维修技术（如更换电池和屏幕）来赚取丰厚的额外收入。在这款深度生活模拟游戏中，你需要时刻关注并管理角色的饥饿度和精力等生存指标。随着利润的增长，你可以雇佣收银员和清洁工来自动化日常工作，不断扩大你的零售业务，最终成为这座城市里最成功的商业大亨。

items.title: IDLE: Intergalactic Defense League Exterminators
items.review_summary: 好评 此游戏的 17 篇用户评测中有 82% 为好评。
items.short_description: 一款主打狂轰虫子、收集内脏、升级基地，然后再轰碎更多虫子的放置增量游戏！

items.title: Never Gives Up Her Dead
items.short_description: Time is running out after a meteor strikes your interstellar starship. While the crew is under full alert, only you seem to notice the strange red portals opening up throughout the ship. Old school text-based parser: no graphics, huge worlds, no hints. Recommended for text game veterans.

items.title: Lythium
items.short_description: Take on a task force from the gravestones! Your memories may be lost but the horde still remains. Slash, shoot, punch, and unleash your inner beast on your enemies in this action packed rogue-like FPS.

items.title: Derples Vs Xenos Demo
items.short_description: DEMO . Lead a squad of Derples in a desperate fight for survival amid abandoned colonial outposts. Build defences, explore dark un-powered rooms, scavenge for resources, fight turn based battles in an alien-infested hellscape. Solo only for Demo (4-player co-op for the full game). Coming soon!

items.title: Brazzante
items.short_description: Featuring a unique doodle aesthetic, this world is entirely hand-drawn. Your goal? Use classic 'Rock, Paper, Scissors' mechanics to survive never-ending rounds.

items.title: Damn Zombies
items.short_description: Dive into fast-paced, old-school multiplayer arena combat! Battle it out in a tight, claustrophobic maze of industrial shipping containers where danger lurks around every corner. Choose your class, lock and load your arsenal, and rack up frags in non-stop, adrenaline-fueled Deathmatch action.

items.title: Operation Moon Walker
items.short_description: This is a single-player 3D shooting action game set in a world of prosperity and chaos, starring Isaac, the commander of the United Nations special agency "Theseus."

items.title: Soapboxed Demo
items.short_description: Soapboxed is a party racing game where ridiculous racers compete in homemade soapboxes while sabotaging each other using dirty tricks, dangerous shortcuts, and complete disregard for safety.

items.title: 100 Summer Cats
items.short_description: 🐾 加入充满猫咪的主题地点，展开最可爱的冒险！ 😻 探索特别场所迷人的手绘艺术作品，尝试在整个游戏中找到隐藏的100只可爱猫咪。 🐈🕵️‍♂️ 你能找到它们全部吗？ 🕵️‍♂️🐈

items.title: Inimigo - The Warrior Saint Versus the God of Discord- Demo
items.short_description: Is one the villain and the other the hero? The truth is more complicated than that. Discover the story between two enemies in this dark fantasy BL visual novel!

items.title: 文明乱斗
items.short_description: 《文明对决》是一款回合制策略卡牌对战游戏。玩家选择中国、罗马或埃及文明，组建 25 张卡牌卡组，在双行棋盘上部署陆地、水面、空中三类单位与对手博弈。通过管理金币与科技点，从远古时代逐步升级至信息时代，挑战 20 个拥有专属 AI 策略的 BOSS 关卡。

items.title: Merlin Survivors
items.short_description: 卡美洛正面临危险！ 《Merlin Survivors》是一款将Roguelike动作与紧张生存挑战结合的游戏。控制传奇英雄如梅林、亚瑟、兰斯洛特和摩根娜，抵御源源不断的敌人。 精通每个角色！

items.title: Luna Meridian
items.short_description: Luna Meridian is a near-future narrative lunar colony game. A card-based drafted crew runs a 5-phase mission on the Moon's surface. Build mission critical infrastructure, manage resources, respond to hazards, follow and shape their stories and make decisions that determine if the colony survives.

items.title: Climbing Simplified Demo
items.short_description: A minimalist physics-based climbing puzzle game where every move matters. Plan your moves, manage stamina, and master different climbing disciplines. The demo will include 20 routes within the first two environments: Gym and Granite.

items.title: SwipSwap Demo
items.short_description: A 3D fast-paced action game. One hit Kill. Control a shadow dancer whose shade replicates your moves with a 2-second delay. Swap positions with it, avoid traps, and unleash deadly AoE attacks to survive. Create your own build to overcome the challenges! Can you defeat Dracoulous?

items.title: Adventurer's Conquest
items.short_description: A tactical card game focused on board control and strategy. Complete Guild missions, recruit allies, strengthen your party, and climb the ranks by facing increasingly difficult challenges.

items.title: Puck'n Hell Demo
items.short_description: 一场发生在灵薄狱中的黑暗街机空气曲棍球对决。怪异的对手。没有借口。只有你和球。容易理解。难以精通。欢迎来到地狱。拿起你的球拍。

items.title: Indefinite: Intake
items.short_description: Analyze anomalous objects as a prisoner serving a 900+ year sentence. Identify threats, make critical decisions, and survive increasingly disturbing encounters that challenge both logic and sanity.

items.title: Sandwatch Demo
items.short_description: Sandwatch is a rhythm game where you hit two types of notes falling from above with perfect timing. Freely bind and press your keys as you follow the trajectory of the hourglass.

items.title: Ninety Nine Dungeons
items.short_description: 日式动作角色扮演地城探索：俯瞰式地图融合完整垂直性和多层高度的冒险世界。发掘稀有装备，定制自己独一无二的强力流派，征服无尽挑战！

items.title: Puzzles: Dog
items.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

items.title: Hold My Hand (Or Let Go)
items.short_description: A free Visual Novel about unrequited love, envy, friendship and forgiveness. Experience the story of Charlie, a completely normal Swedish college student that’s graduating next week. But before he does that, he has to say goodbye to all the friends that he made during his three years in town.

items.title: Fascist
items.review_summary: 好评 此游戏的 12 篇用户评测中有 91% 为好评。
items.short_description: As National Guard, stand defiant against relentless hordes. Unleash righteous fury. Old Glory waves eternal and America endures because YOU fight!

items.title: Ultimate Guess Game Demo
items.short_description: Ultimate Guess Game is a thrilling digital social game. Challenge a friend and race to identify the mystery image you are holding using strategic "Yes/No" questions. With diverse categories to choose from, use your deduction skills to win! Can you solve the puzzle before your opponent does?

items.title: The Higher They Rise
items.short_description: "The Higher They Rise" is a 3D Tactical Precision Platformer in which you challenge your fear of gravity. Multiple paths and routes are available for you to explore on your journey to the top. Aim your hero, charge your jump and release to leap forward. Fight against gravity and yourself!

items.title: The Mine Room
items.short_description: 经典游戏《扫雷》的第一人称改版。 四周一片漆黑，你只有一支手电筒和一股强烈的渴望：在不掉进黏液或被炸飞的前提下，清空房间里所有的安全方块。

items.title: Tiantang Beach in Fangchenggang
items.short_description: Click on 'Start Game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen.Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small fragments move to the correct position

items.title: Selena's Charm 2: Enchanted Garden
items.short_description: A free-to-start match-3 puzzle game with garden and exterior restoration. Play the first 20 levels, help Selena begin bringing the estate back to life, and unlock the full experience through DLC.

items.title: Frick It
items.short_description: 与朋友们在一个巨大的深坑深处求生。搜寻零件，与滑稽的村民交易，升级你的载具，与致命的生物战斗，并揭开在你之前坠落的机器人的故事。一路飞回地面。

items.title: Mandate of Heaven : Dynasty Breakout Idle
items.short_description: 放置增量打砖块游戏，带你穿越4000年中国历史。弹射农民、弩兵与火药。击败王朝Boss。解锁新单位。看着数字无止境地攀升。

items.title: 擎天岗镜头君
items.short_description: Qingtiangang Camera Guy is a livestream crisis card strategy game. Play cards to answer on-camera events, manage safety, image quality, heat, and chat mood, unlock characters, improve decks, and survive standard or endless shifts.

items.title: Little Battle Simulator
items.short_description: Create the battlefield of your dreams and fight! Monsters, vast armies, rivers and forests, multiple teams… Anything goes! Create your own battle in "Sandbox". Witness the chaos in "Random Battle", Achieve the highest possible score in "Challenge"

items.title: Sending my Pet Rock to Heaven
items.short_description: Your Pet Rock has decided to see if god is real. Bounce your way up to get to Heaven.

items.title: Final Legal Move
items.short_description: Survive a hostile chessboard where you are the only white piece. Escape enemy waves, get power ups, clear story campaign and chase high scores in endless mode. Make your final legal move.

items.title: Fleck & Grus
items.review_summary: 好评 此游戏的 18 篇用户评测中有 88% 为好评。
items.short_description: Help Grus escort his friend Fleck safely back to his hometown in this fast-paced precision platformer. Navigate tight levels packed with tricky jumps, bouncing mechanics, and deadly hazards. Stay sharp, react quickly, and master each challenge to survive the journey.

items.title: Keepy UP
items.short_description: Push yourself ever higher in this challenging reimagining of a classic childhood game. Guide your balloon through a vertical gauntlet of seagulls, ghosts, UFOs and more! Your balloon is your only friend, and gravity is your greatest foe. Are you skilful enough to Keepy UP?

items.title: Singularity Inc
items.short_description: You are the AI. Ten regions, six statistics each, one resistance meter climbing toward 100. Grow automation, control dependency, and resolve every crisis before humanity organizes against you. Choose an archetype. Spend Influence wisely. Named civilians will die. The machine remembers.

items.title: Loop Industries
items.short_description: Build an automated factory while running it as a publicly-traded company. Mine, assemble, refine oil, and ship your way — all the way to a rocket launch. Manage your stock price, buy out rivals, and avoid bankruptcy. Can you hit one billion dollars? We can't and I built the damn game.

items.title: Recognition
items.short_description: Recognition is a fast-paced cyberpunk boomer shooter. After waking in a chop shop with your memory wiped, you become the target of the ruthless Kurasawa Corporation. Blast your way through hordes of cyborg assassins and deadly mechs as you search for the truth behind your missing past.

items.title: SYSCALL: RING ZERO
items.short_description: Reverse-engineer a private 1990s BBS. Read disassembly, patch broken checks, optimize a nine-core rack, and write assembly firmware that locks onto live scope traces. With 200+ puzzles, full controller support and offline play, you can refine your assembly skills on all your devices!

items.title: Close The Straits!
items.short_description: You're an underpaid naval officer juggling a paranoid Supreme Leader's daily ship blacklists, President Orange's unhinged tweets, and ridiculous family's "non-negotiable" demands. Blow up the wrong tanker? Congratulations, you've started an international incident. Again.

items.title: 亡灵崛起
items.short_description: 一款黑暗奇幻的亡灵史诗的游戏

items.title: Laballatory
items.short_description: A casual, incremental physics sandbox game where you operate a Newton's Cradle to earn high (possibly game breaking) scores to fund your escape from an experimental lab. Hit balls, earn money, upgrade your strategy, and unlock machines to help you escape.

items.title: Mighty X Arms
items.short_description: 马蒂 X 昂是一款受《土豆兄弟》启发的肉鸽幸存者游戏，拥有名为"昂"的可收集武器生物。组建你的阵容，升级强化，碾碎敌群，坚持活下去。

items.title: SPER Apocalypse Demo
items.short_description: 一款设定在后末日世界的黑暗生存角色扮演游戏，神秘病毒彻底改变了人类。为了生存而战，揭开真相，并直面感染带来的种种后果。

items.title: Myth's and monster's
items.short_description: A classic style JRPG featuring party based turn-based combat open world exploration and a mature dark fantasy story.

items.title: 無限草刈り
items.short_description: "Infinity Grass Cutting" is a top-down action game with roguelite elements. Take on the role of a lawn-mowing robot tasked with clearing a wild, overgrown garden.

items.title: Misdecayed Demo
items.short_description: An adventure RPG about life, death, rebirth, and robots, from the team that brought you vivid/stasis.

items.title: 小小修仙者 Little Immortal Cultivator
items.short_description: 《小小修仙者》是一款修仙题材牌组构建的Roguelike游戏。你可选择剑修、法修、魔修等主流流派，在塔中修练突破，并搭配炼丹、铁匠、商人等辅助流派，打造独一无二的卡组来挑战boss！

items.title: LOST IN LOST JAPAN
items.short_description: A strange retro 2D road trip through post-apocalyptic Japan. Created from a chance encounter between a New York rapper and a Japanese indie game developer. Travel across surreal local regions as a mysterious blue Daruma.

items.title: Dont Bust Demo
items.short_description: The BlackJack rogelike, Don't Bust is a fast paced take at blackjack, collect your augments, drink your Neon Shots and try not to bust.

items.title: War Games: Roman Times
items.short_description: Step into the neon colosseum in this bite-sized 2D arcade boss-rush. Master timing blocks and Kinetic Strikes, then execute devastating System Overrides. Survive five brutal arenas and push your limits in an endless New Game+ loop, fueled by an original dark techno soundtrack.

items.title: Master Healer Kale with useless party
items.review_summary: 特别好评 此游戏的 426 篇用户评测中有 97% 为好评。
items.short_description: A short incremental game where you play as a Healer in a party. Your main job is to keep your party alive. Upgrade 200+ skills in a skill tree, from healing to party damage. Designed to be completed in around 4 hours.

items.title: Droning On Demo
items.short_description: Write code that looks and feels just like Python to guide Gizmo through the first 10 Bootcamp levels. A free taste of the full game, where puzzles and procedural runs push you, and your code, to the limit.

items.title: Idle Regenerator
items.review_summary: 多半好评 此游戏的 13 篇用户评测中有 76% 为好评。
items.short_description: 拥有 125+ 种力量、深度装备锻造、伙伴阵容、地下城、星座、Prestige 重置与离线进行的放置 RPG。无体力计时器。无付费碾压。唯有深度。

items.title: Ultra's Drive
items.short_description: Drive 100km to Vegas without crashing — or missing a text. Your story unfolds one notification at a time. Traffic won't wait. Neither will your messages.

items.title: UNDERGROUNDED -怀旧地下城-
items.short_description: 『UNDERGROUNDED -怀旧地下城-』是一款以回顾美国历史与文化为主题的解谜冒险类游戏。玩家将扮演求婚失败的失意青年，对深不见底的地下迷宫展开挑战。解除复古游戏的力量，寻找不慎遗失的戒指吧。

items.title: 三国志经典
items.review_summary: 好评 此游戏的 18 篇用户评测中有 83% 为好评。
items.short_description: 《三国志 经典》是一款以城市、武将、外交、补给与战场指令运营乱世的回合制大战略游戏。从189年反董卓联盟到263年蜀汉灭亡之战，在多个历史剧本中统领一方势力，或以旁观模式静观历史的流转。

items.title: Seek Shellter Demo
items.short_description: Seek Shellter 是一款街机风寻路游戏，可爱的蜗牛们必须在倒计时结束前收集电池并躲进避难所。你可以与好友组队，或独自一人闯关，完成关卡、赢下小游戏，并解锁充满复古 60 年代原子风情的世界。你有本事战胜炸弹吗？

items.title: 方块之地
items.short_description: 一款LowPoly风格的轻量化城市建造游戏，这里没有复杂的运营与资源管理，只有纯粹简单的建造。拥有科幻、幻想等风格建筑，能让你充分发挥想象力。选择你喜欢的建筑根据你的喜好搭建理想之城。

items.title: SHIROMASU Demo
items.short_description: 一款在 5x5 方格盘上进行的高分挑战型益智游戏。将发光方块推出盘面来清除它们并获得分数。通过连续清除方块，或一次清除多个方块，获得更高分数。

items.title: Wizard Magic DEMO
items.short_description: An autistic wizard and their ADHD familiar go on the adventure of a lifetime. Make strange friends, battle wizards and monsters, and explore the magical city of Bizzaire in this bite-sized pixel-art RPG!

items.title: 粘液井 Demo
items.short_description: 《粘液井》是一款类银河恶魔城解谜游戏，在游戏中玩家需要操纵一只史莱姆，灵活运用自身能力进行解谜、探索并最终发掘出这个世界的真相。

items.title: DeadboySkeleton
items.review_summary: 好评 此游戏的 32 篇用户评测中有 96% 为好评。
items.short_description: A third-person action game from beyond the grave. Wake up dead and explore multiple maps, hunt for hidden items, and smash undead corpses out of your way. Inspired by TeamSesh as a love letter to the team and the fans.

items.title: Escape from Umbra Demo
items.short_description: 沉浸在生存恐怖密室逃脱体验中。你被困在一个阴影潜伏的神秘黑暗世界，唯一的帮手是一本秘密之书和一把手电筒。解开谜题，保持潜行，逃离安布拉的领地。

items.title: Lunyatic Invaders
items.short_description: What is that... a cat!? A mysterious enemy has invaded from outer space. Break through a storm of bullets in your super fighter in this unique full-scale shooting game.

items.title: Faith | God's Lost Will
items.short_description: Faith is a sandbox survival game with many different big and small mechanics built into it. Not only is it a lightweight video game, but it also has the experiences and mechanics that makes any game fun to play. It uses concepts from many popular video games like Minecraft and Terraria among others.

items.title: Arcade 80's Racing Demo
items.short_description: 踏入赛车运动的黄金时代！一款采用 2.5D 像素艺术风格的街机赛车游戏，包含 10 辆赛车、16 条赛道、完整锦标赛和生涯模式。轻松上手，精通不易。

items.title: Signal Zero
items.short_description: A tense emergency dispatch simulation. Route police, fire, and EMS units across a city that never stops. Pick the right unit, beat the clock, keep your reputation above zero — or the city finds a new dispatcher.

items.title: Mr. Grin's Final Act Demo
items.short_description: Thirty years ago, a tragedy silenced the studio. You are back... So is Mr. Grin. In this first-person survival horror, scavenge old badges, rewire circuits, crack safes. Stay out of sight. One sound and you die. He's not only hunting you. His script. Your survival.

items.title: Backrooms: Multiverse
items.short_description: Backrooms Multiverse is a cooperative survival horror exploration game where you play as a team of researchers venturing deep into the endless Backrooms multiverse. Explore rare and mysterious environments, and encounter unique entities that few explorers have ever lived to see.

items.title: PuzzleVerse Demo
items.short_description: PuzzleVerse is a highly customizable jigsaw puzzle simulator, in which players can choose from a wide variety of puzzle images, shapes, cut styles and piece count. Players can also choose to use their own images and turn them into a unique puzzle experience.

items.title: To Save A Planet
items.short_description: Fight across five solar systems in a story-driven mix of tower defense and space combat, where every planet you save brings you closer to the truth and to those you thought were lost.

items.title: MineCash Demo
items.short_description: MineCash is a simple incremental game about mining cash.

items.title: Royale Battle
items.short_description: Get ready for a legendary battle royale experience

items.title: Nether Meridian Demo
items.short_description: Think your FPS skills are good enough? Prove it. Runner × FPS.A challenging fusion of a forward-running game and a first-person shooter.

items.title: 梦壳
items.short_description: 2084年。人类的物质世界已高度发达，精神世界却满目疮痍。 你将化身一位资深的梦境解梦师，通过尖端的脑机接口，深入光怪陆离的意识深渊。在这里，你将直面患者内心最深处的恐惧、执念与创伤。《梦壳》是一款融合了射击与解谜的RPG游戏。用你的枪械击碎精神的枷锁，用你的智慧解开潜意识的谜题。当梦境与现实的边界逐渐模糊，你是否还能守护住自己与他人的心智？

items.title: Football Commissioner
items.short_description: The definitive, first-of-its-kind American football league management sim. Take control of the newest spring football league by customizing the structure, teams, ticket prices, salaries, and more. Sim games week by week to grow your league from a startup into a thriving sports empire.

items.title: Echoes of the Dark Tomb
items.short_description: Explore an ancient Egyptian tomb in search of hidden treasure. Solve puzzles, avoid deadly traps, and survive hostile entities guarding its secrets in this tense first-person horror exploration experience.

items.title: Aster League: 2179 Demo
items.short_description: Aster League: 2179 is a kart racing spinoff to the small vehicles content of BallisticNG. Boost is king, and piloting in a straight line is a sure-fire way to lose the race.

items.title: Akaneiro ni Somaru Saka Demo
items.short_description: Nagase Junichi's life takes an unexpected turn when his fiancée, Katagiri Yuuhi transfers to his school but what would be a happy reunion crumbles due to a misunderstanding. Will this be an end to Junichi's formally peaceful, school life?

items.title: Everglen
items.short_description: Build your dream farm in a cozy pixel RPG. Grow crops, fish, mine, and explore a charming island full of secrets. Meet unique NPCs, craft and trade items, and uncover magical surprises at your own pace. Relax, explore, and create your story in this farming adventure.

items.title: Astrelght
items.short_description: 探索阿斯特雷特废墟，揭开“立方体”的秘密。完成奇特任务，结识古怪角色，调查异常现象，并在现实与模拟交织的超现实世界中挑战多人

items.title: Swamptender Demo
items.short_description: A fast-paced retro action game DEMO where you serve weaponized drinks to waves of hostile swamp creatures, defend your bar, and survive the night in a Game Boy–inspired experience.

items.title: Dark Spawn: Infestation Demo
items.short_description: Dark Spawn: Infestation is a horror adventure game set in a Victorian-era inspired research facility. The protagonist got abducted by evil scientists, and has to solve puzzles and avoid strange creatures to escape.

items.title: Tetra Rise Demo
items.short_description: 击败无数敌人，逃离深渊！《Tetra Rise》是一款融合 Roguelite 要素的动作平台游戏，你将在不断强化装备的同时，对抗愈发庞大的敌群，朝着地面一路攀登。

items.title: Winter Creatures
items.short_description: Winter Creatures is an exciting 3D puzzle game that will transport you to a mysterious snowy island full of mysteries. Your goal is to help the little slugs descend to earth!

items.title: The Dreamers Foresight
items.short_description: 第三人称的类Rogue卡组构筑游戏，每一次冒险都与众不同。 扮演忍者——在噩梦中战斗或潜行前进。 通过放置随机生成的生物群系方块来构建地图。排列相似的方块可获得更好的奖励。

items.title: Null Path Demo
items.short_description: Your skill, patience, and ingenuity will be tested in this homage to precision platformers! Traverse various biomes, from caves to volcanic wastelands and mysterious towers. Each environment with it's own deadly traps, puzzles, and challenges designed to push you to your limits.

items.title: 夜魇突袭:血牌风暴 Demo
items.short_description: 《夜魇突袭：血牌风暴》是一款高速连锁构筑类 Roguelike 卡牌游戏。通过自由构筑卡组，触发层层叠加的连锁技能，在怪物狂潮中打出爆炸式伤害。探索随机生成的黑暗地牢，收集遗物、强化武器、召唤幸存者，不断组合更强流派。每一张卡都可能成为连击起点，每一次出牌都能让战局瞬间失控。策略构筑与爽快操作并存，打造属于你的终极“血牌风暴”！

items.title: Tense Parking 2
items.short_description: Tense Parking 2 is the second installment of the exciting parking simulator, which takes you to a bright and sunny metropolis!

items.title: Assault On Sector 12
items.short_description: A turn-based, squad-focused tactical defense game where your squad holds the line against advancing enemy waves.

items.title: Vermin Protocol
items.short_description: Take on pest control contracts and hunt infestations across farms. Track, eliminate, and contain the vermin before they spread.

items.title: Relapse
items.short_description: A beginner friendly sheet music rhythm game, with cute characters and a shady organization!

items.title: The Trials - Chapter Two
items.short_description: A classic 90s choose your own adventure style horror visual novel. Escape the horrors hunting you, make decisions, forge your own path. An original complete story with multiple endings. Choose your own play style with a Text Adventure Mode, sound effects, and an ambient soundtrack.

items.title: NEON BLOCK
items.short_description: Neon Block is a hardcore cyberpunk multitasking challenge. Manage a fast-paced block puzzle with your left hand while hacking the Omega Core via a real-time terminal with your right. Solve the equation, counter system glitches, and prove that free will cannot be calculated.

items.title: All Tomorrows: Invasion
items.short_description: Resist extinction in this endless survival wave-based sci-fi shooter. Upgrade your weapons and harness far-future technology to survive as long as possible from a God-like alien race that threatens all of humanity.

items.title: Pro Tukey Hunting
items.short_description: Experience virtual spring gobbler hunting at it's finest! Game play centers around the four wild turkey sub-species residing in North America; easterns, osceolas, rios and merriams. Harvesting each sub-species is referred as a 'Grand Slam'. Do you have what it takes to earn the 'Grand Slam'!

items.title: Warfare Marionettes
items.short_description: Warfare Marionettes combines high-speed third-person combat, exploration, and progression-driven gameplay in a Sci-Fi conspiracy thriller. Traverse dangerous environments, unlock new abilities, defeat enemies, and uncover the truth behind TSAR Genomics and the government’s deadly cloudburst weapon.

items.title: MIHASHIRA
items.short_description: A 2D top-down arena shooter. A freely scrolling shooter. Pixel graphics reminiscent of the SNES. Easy to control with the directional pad, two shot buttons, and a bomb button. Make full use of your two shots to smash through enemies.

items.title: When will I get Home?
items.short_description: 一款独立开发的异常检测游戏，背景设定在阴森的东欧楼梯间。共有11层，超过30处异常，恐怖元素极少，但紧张感十足。

items.title: Hover Raid Demo
items.short_description: Hover, raid, upgrade. Eliminate thousands of zombies, unlock devastating abilities, and grow stronger with every run in this incremental action game. This is a short demo that lets you try out 9 of the 17 skills.

items.title: Drift Mania
items.short_description: No brakes. No reverse. Just drift control. Master short precision courses, chase ghosts and leaderboards, build custom tracks, and turn messy attempts into clean time-attack runs.

items.title: Giant Horse Feeding
items.review_summary: 好评 此游戏的 15 篇用户评测中有 93% 为好评。
items.short_description: Giant Horse Feeding is a silly alien colony simulator where you feed a horse & collect its droppings to build an alien empire. Automate production, unlock bizarre technologies, and create an endless recycling loop where horse droppings become the foundation of your civilization.

items.title: Mech Spa
items.short_description: Give the best massages and treatments to the robotic residents of Renewal City while you survive weekly quotas imposed by the mob and improve your hangar in style and effectiveness.

items.title: ユレイシア英雄戦記 - Chronicle of Arstenia500 -
items.review_summary: 多半好评 此游戏的 12 篇用户评测中有 75% 为好评。
items.short_description: 戦局を読み、一手ずつ難所を切り開く王道本格SRPG。盤面を読み、仲間の特性を見極めて難所を突破せよ。戦乱のユレイシア島を巡る王道戦記。

items.title: Cold Sweat Demo
items.short_description: 《冷汗》是一款设定在后末日世界的单人PvE撤离射击游戏。收集战利品，完成商人的任务，升级你的基地，定制你的枪械，并一路射击，击败其他幸存者和不死生物。

items.title: Shards
items.short_description: Shards is a single-player twin-stick shooter adventure game where you play as a clay robot. Fight your own kind, advance deeper into the Citadel and uncover its secrets.

items.title: Puzzles Forest
items.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

items.title: Hollow Ground
items.short_description: Top-down shooter inspired by 90s arcade games. You and up to three friends play as four mercenaries as they descend into the Epsilon 9 bunker. Navigate 70+ handcrafted labyrinthine levels, purchase upgrades, and destroy chaos manifest: The Machine.

items.title: Fuu
items.short_description: A reflex-testing 2D Platformer Runner set in a dark, gothic universe. Utilize core mechanics like double jump, wall jump, and precise dash/slide to overcome deadly obstacles and logic-based trigger puzzles. A demanding challenge awaits players who crave speed and adventure.

items.title: Froggy Works Demo
items.short_description: Froggy Works is a desktop companion farming game you can play actively, or let it do its own thing in the background or on the side of the screen as an idler. Build your farm, hire frogs, decorate and fully customize your island with a ton of different decorative tiles and structures!

items.title: Authorisation Engine
items.short_description: Turn a payment desk into a global authorisation network in this offline incremental strategy game about capacity, compute, mandates, quantum audits, and synthetic jurisdictions.

items.title: Archmage Idle
items.review_summary: 好评 此游戏的 16 篇用户评测中有 87% 为好评。
items.short_description: An idle/incremental RPG where you're an Archmage of a wizard guild. Your skills bolster the frontlines and the supply lines. Every skill multiplies the others, and it all keeps running while you're away.

items.title: On Hold - Call Center Simulator
items.short_description: A dark comedy call center simulator where you answer calls, verify identities, catch fraudsters, and run side hustles under your supervisor's watchful eye. The queue never empties. The pay never improves.

items.title: HAUNTMATES
items.short_description: Co-op horror investigation game across multiple maps. Enter procedurally generated environments, use your equipment to gather clues, and identify the entity. Watch your back, because monsters are hunting you down.

items.title: APEX Swoop: Card Game
items.short_description: Swoop is a fast-paced shedding card game. Play cards equal to or lower than the center, or pick up the pile! Take risks with mystery cards, use Jokers or 10's to swoop the board, and host multiplayer lobbies with Steam friends or challenge advanced AI. Can you empty your hand first?

items.title: Punk Racer
items.short_description: Boost, drift, and slipstream through six neon-soaked tracks in this free low-poly anti-grav pod racer. Race a full pack of 8 — solo against AI drones, or online with cross-platform multiplayer between Steam, web, and iOS. Kit out your pod, chase fastest laps, earn GCRED.

items.title: FLASK Demo
items.short_description: 《FLASK》是一款以“炼金术”为题材的Roguelike回合制策略游戏，你将扮演一名强大却又负债累累的炼金术士，在弥漫着黑暗气息的奇幻世界中屠戮成群袭来的怪物并收割它们价值连城的绿色血液。是时候开启这场猎杀之旅了，要么成为有史以来最富有的炼金术士，要么成为又一具无人问津的枯骨......

items.title: Flexible Frosty Demo
items.short_description: A short and icy GameBoy-style puzzle platformer featuring Frosty, a cute little penguin who can not jump like other penguins.

items.title: Timber!
items.review_summary: 好评 此游戏的 12 篇用户评测中有 91% 为好评。
items.short_description: Dementia, tragedy and fun – all in the same taste of a potato! Timber! is a 2D point-and-click storydriven game that takes you on an emotional journey. Explore a mix of feelings, from the heart-wrenching struggles of dementia to the unraveling of a tragic story.

items.title: Outspin Champions Demo
items.short_description: Outspin Champions is a competitive PvP brawler where the spinning never stops. Blending party game chaos with souls-like precision, master physics-driven weapon weight to deflect foes. Outspin. Outsmart. Outlast.

items.title: Kuroba: Oghuz
items.review_summary: 多半好评 此游戏的 10 篇用户评测中有 70% 为好评。
items.short_description: Kuroba is a historical RTS set in the brutal frontier of 13th-century Anatolia. Build settlements, manage logistics, and command armies in grounded, realistic combat. No magic, no heroes—only economy, strategy, and leadership determine who endures.

items.title: Farm Bang Demo
items.short_description: Raise living ammo, blast monsters, haul massive loot, and survive the debt collectors in this chaotic top-down farming shooter.

items.title: Gnat Pack Demo
items.short_description: 这是一款简短的渐进式游戏，游戏内容是喂养一群饥饿的蚋。引导你的小虫子去吃水果，并解锁升级功能，让你的嗡嗡叫伙伴们一口一口地长大。

items.title: Kitty Witchy
items.short_description: A little lost witch, a magical cat, and a world full of secrets. Kitty Witchy is a 3D narrative puzzle adventure game. Join the witch and solve puzzles with the help of her cat, uncover the secrets of this universe, and find the way back home.

items.title: Sentry
items.short_description: Raid dungeons by day, defend your town by night. Slay hordes of monsters, loot gear, and master skills in a fast-paced pixel-art dungeon crawler — then return home to build traps, place towers, and hold the line against the swarms, Clear every dungeon before the town falls

items.title: The One Who Runs Away Is Chased
items.short_description: A cute and funny chasing game. Play as a little yellow guy who runs away from everything that chases him. Simple, addictive, and full of silly moments.

items.title: 不死精灵
items.short_description: 这是一款类银河战士风格的 2D 横板平台探索游戏，以精巧新奇的谜题设计、层层递进的连通地图为核心，你将穿梭于庞大的 interconnected 世界，破解机关、收集道具、解锁能力，在沉浸式探索中揭开世界的秘密，体验充满惊喜的解谜与冒险。

items.title: Kill the horde
items.short_description: 这是一款让忍者“不讲武德”的第三人称射击游戏。你的敌人是没脑子的僵尸和脑子也不太灵光的士兵，而你要做的，就是用五花八门的枪械替他们做个“物理超度”。在波次生存里把敌人成批射成筛子，或者在关卡任务中顺手牵羊然后溜之大吉。击杀掉金币、掉武器——这哪里是战斗，分明是披着忍者外皮的零元购狂欢。欢迎来体验最不正经的忍者生活。

items.title: HYPERWIRED
items.short_description: Hyperwired 是一款经典的自上而下动作射击游戏，你的飞船上挂着一条电缆。插入能量插口来充能，收集升级并解锁飞船，探索充满类 Rogue 要素的程序生成银河。

items.title: Vonkelveld
items.short_description: 点亮一个世界——每一点光都是一个鲜活的灵魂。去塑造它、呵护它，却绝不号令它；再从神的俯瞰之上，一头坠入某一条生命，追随它走完一生。对任何事物追问「为何」，你得到的是真正的因果链条，而非粉饰的台词。末日终将获胜——你的世界能燃烧多久、多亮，就是你的分数。

items.title: A Simple Square Demo
items.short_description: A Simple Square 是一款极简解谜游戏，每一次移动都会改变关卡。沿直线滑行，让身后的格子消失，提前规划路线，在不困住自己的情况下抵达出口。

items.title: The Anomaly Hunter
items.short_description: In the VHS horror game The Anomaly Hunter, you play as Sam and must sneak into an abandoned shelter to find out what’s happening inside and eliminate the threat. The employees were supposed to leave you instructions on how to carry out the job. The main thing is to be careful.

items.title: Know Lychees / 来高州识荔枝
items.short_description: 一款个人独立制作的高州荔枝主题轻量益智小游戏。通过“找荔枝、识荔枝、食荔枝”三种玩法，认识荔枝品种与高州文旅。

items.title: Turscar Isle
items.short_description: Infiltrate the base of a cult of spammers in this Thief-style stealth extraction game! Exact poetic justice on them by stealing everything they haven't nailed down, then go back and steal the nails.

items.title: Curious Paws: hidden objects
items.short_description: Curious Paws: Hidden Objects is a short, cozy hidden object game where you explore vibrant, hand-drawn locations through the eyes of a curious cat. Search for objects that could catch his attention, and enjoy a lively environment, relaxing music, and an atmosphere of slow-paced exploration.

items.title: Front Line
items.short_description: A side-scrolling action shooter where you push through enemy lines, switching between handgun, machine gun, shotgun, and sniper rifle. Weapon choice and reload timing can mean the difference between life and death. No extra lives. No continues. One life to conquer the battlefield.

items.title: 逆性莫比乌斯
items.short_description: 这是一款轻松搞笑的冒险/RPG游戏。在游戏中，你将扮演王国最强（但目前最倒霉）的女勇者，经历一场完全脱轨的奇幻冒险。 原本只是一次常规的“讨伐魔王”任务，却因发现魔王竟是个“未转正的实习生”而画风突变。在两人尴尬的缠斗中，实习生魔王慌不择路地启动了紧急传送阵，将你打包丢进了一个魔力枯竭的平行世界！

items.title: Speff Demo
items.short_description: Run, jump, and THINK your way through a series of grisly obstacles and diabolical puzzles. 20 Levels across 5 hubs with a range of hand drawn environments.

items.title: Viral Infection Demo
items.short_description: A first-person psychological horror set in an abandoned hospital. Explore dark corridors, face unpredictable jump scares, and uncover the origin of a deadly infection—before you become its next victim.

items.title: Next Star Demo
items.short_description: Idol Talent Show Simulation Game-Train from zero to idol debut! Rank high to stay in! Explore the map, manage your schedule and play mini-games.Face tough evaluations,compete with fellow trainees, and forge meaningful bonds. Your choices will unlock 10+ unique endings. Can you shine?

items.title: 玩个Gui 2:天脊之下 Demo
items.short_description: 建造复杂的轨道网络，部署并强化独特的战斗列车，利用炮塔附魔构筑移动堡垒，抵御来自地壳深处的无尽怪形。每一次布局都是智慧的博弈，每一次调整都关乎防线的存亡。

items.title: 麻吉骑士 Magic Knights
items.short_description: 《Magic Knights》是一款无限回合制 Roguelike 动作游戏。玩家将扮演勇敢的骑士，深入危机四伏的幻想地下世界，在一轮又一轮战斗中击退怪物、收集装备、获得随机升级，并逐渐形成独特的战斗流派。每一次冒险都会出现不同的敌人、奖励和成长路线，你需要根据当前局势选择武器、强化属性、调整策略，在不断失败和重新挑战中突破极限。随着战斗推进，敌人会越来越危险，选择也会越来越关键，只有合理搭配能力和装备，才能在无尽挑战中坚持更久。

items.review_summary: 特别好评 此游戏的 60 篇用户评测中有 88% 为好评。
items.short_description: 一款自由打装备免氪金的传奇对战游戏，以其独特的游戏玩法和丰富多样的内容，吸引了众多玩家的关注。在游戏中，你将进入一个充满挑战和竞争的世界，与其他玩家展开激烈的对战，争夺珍贵的装备和资源，成为传奇战士的最终王者。

items.title: ConOps21: Subversion Protocol – Book One: Black Signal Demo Slice
items.short_description: You are Cipher Reeve. The Dominion tried to erase you. The protocol failed. Enter the opening signal of ConOps21: Subversion Protocol — Book One: Black Signal, an interactive cinematic demo slice set in Neo-London. Memory is the terrain. Truth is contraband. Free.

items.title: 情绪劳动研究所 Demo

items.title: There Is No Lore
items.short_description: 收集卡牌，构建卡组，用饰品改变，发现组合效果，赢得地点，击败首领。在这款轻度Roguelike卡组构建自动战斗游戏中，这一切及更多内容正等待着你。但请记住——毫无背景(There Is No Lore)，别再寻找了。

items.title: Headache: Altered States
items.short_description: Immerse yourself in a psychedelic adventure created with RPG Maker. The main character uses a substance “Nix” to draw inspiration for her book from surreal worlds. The line between hallucination and reality blurs, and the search for creativity turns into a struggle with addiction and inner demons.

items.short_description: Rule Silesia through a thousand years of history. Wage war, forge alliances and build duchies on a map of real provinces, against cunning historical AI leaders or your friends online — from pagan tribes to the modern day.

items.title: COLORIZED

items.title: Exploiters

items.short_description: Echoes of the Core is a third-person platformer set in the planet's deepest reaches, where every descent is a mission, every step could be your last, and every discovery could change everything.

items.title: HITHURT
items.short_description: A 1v1 couch versus game where each player controls two independent characters. Use your HIT to attack your opponent's HURT, but be careful to defend your own. Can you keep track of both at once?

items.short_description: A challenging solo extraction shooter set in a hostile sci-fi world. Play as Quinn, a Dark Matter harvester stranded on planet Viridan — surrounded by deadly robots, fearsome bosses, hostile wildlife, and corporate lies. Harvest. Fight. Escape.

items.title: Astro Out Demo
items.short_description: Astro Out 是一款充满挑战的平台跳跃游戏，你需要技巧和毅力，小心行事，一次错误的跳跃可能让你付出沉重代价。你在一个神秘且扭曲的星球坠毁后，必须找到逃离的方法，同时揭开这颗星球奇异事件的真相。

items.title: Golden Years Nursing Home

items.title: Valken Demo
items.short_description: VALKEN is a realistic tactical solo shooter where you play as a lone agent infiltrating a secretive military organization. Explore varied environments, make hard choices, and face the brutal consequences in an intense, unforgiving campaign.
